verdict.rationale: Stripe's core platform supports webhooks for payment lifecycle events (payment_intent.succeeded, charge.refunded, charge.dispute.created, etc.) via a generic webhooks system, and refunds/disputes APIs exist, but the evidence pack shows no Terminal-specific documentation confirming that in-person payment lifecycle events (authorized/captured/refunded/disputed) are emitted through the same webhook mechanism as online payments—only general webhook docs and separate refund/dispute docs are cited.
